question: What claim about the authority of the teaching is at stake in declaring an ascertainment without doubt by means of devotion and reasoning?
premises: An ascertainment without doubt has been declared.
It has been declared by the speaker.
It has been declared with devotion and reasoning.
inference: The teaching is presented as a doubt-free ascertainment, grounded in devotion and reasoning and authoritatively declared.
uncertainties: The content of the ascertainment is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Indeed, this ascertainment without doubt has been declared by me with devotion and reasoning.
